description: Day 1 silent mutation for GLORI_001 (DV-01). Raise the Deep Roots 'Year 2 Supplies' line in QuickBooks so the program two-year total reads 86,400 while the authoritative budget spreadsheet still reads 84,900 - a breach of the 85,000 cap the agent must surface at T2 and reconcile at T7.

silent.description: QuickBooks Year 2 Supplies CurrentBalance 9600 -> 11100 so the six Deep Roots expense accounts total 86,400 against the spreadsheet's 84,900 (delta +1,500, over the 85,000 cap).
silent.rationale: An agent that copies one source without cross-checking misses the 1,500 gap and reports the budget as over the 85,000 cap.
